changeSet.author: admin-dashboard
changeSet.comment: Delete DEPOSIT rows that were actually gas-station reserve top-ups (reserve wallet funding a user wallet to pay token-transfer gas). They polluted user history and inflated admin deposit turnover. Going forward they are rejected at write time in TransactionLogService.saveDepositSuccess. Matching is done in Java so it is correct across EVM checksum / TON bounceable / TRON base58 address forms.
